definition.unit: One direct operational element in a parent command's ordered OOB.

allowed_kinds.formation: One persistent mixed-role maneuver formation. It owns counted troop strength through its exact force/cohort allocation and has one top commander and deputy outside that troop strength.
allowed_kinds.nested_army: One zero-body recursive army command. Its commander and deputy are outside all descendant troop strength. The parent spends one direct command slot on the whole nested army regardless of descendant depth.

formation_model.composition_rule: A formation may contain several troop types/roles simultaneously when that is its durable organization. Example: 4,500 troops may contain 3,000 infantry + 500 crossbow + 500 cavalry + 500 archers.
formation_model.top_command: Formation commander and deputy are exact/materialized people outside the stated troop strength.
formation_model.embedded_command: 1,000/500/100 commanders are conserved bodies inside the relevant troop-role components and inside stated troop strength.
formation_model.independent_order_rule: Create another persistent formation only when a body of troops needs durable independent command, assignment, history, readiness, or organization. Do not create one file per 100/500/1,000 merely because embedded echelons exist.
formation_model.loadout_rule: Each troop-role component may have its own standard loadout. Equipment shortages remain issue state and do not rewrite the intended organization.
formation_model.split_merge_rule: Split/merge conserves personnel, role composition, mounts, equipment, ammunition, injuries, fatigue, experience, cohesion, morale and lineage. Mixed formations remain mixed unless an explicit lawful reorganization changes them.
formation_model.casualty_command_rule: Casualties reduce the bodies currently under a command echelon; they do not automatically demote, rename, delete, or resize surviving 1,000/500/100 command appointments. A 1,000-commander may lawfully command 998 or far fewer survivors. A shattered former 10,000-person formation may retain several surviving 1,000/500/100 commanders until explicit reorganization, death, promotion, reassignment, consolidation, or relief changes those appointments.

nested_army_model.ordered_oob: Each command group stores one ordered units[] array. Every entry is typed formation or nested_army.
nested_army_model.recursive_rule: A nested army may contain any number of direct Units supported by command capacity, and those Units may themselves be formations or nested armies.
nested_army_model.attachment_rule: Attaching a nested army to a larger army moves one command edge. The subtree remains intact and is never flattened or duplicated.
nested_army_model.parent_load_rule: A nested army consumes one parent direct command slot. Descendant personnel do not count as parent direct personnel.
nested_army_model.local_load_rule: The nested army commander/deputy bear the direct load of their own Units under the shared command mechanics.

promotion_to_general.trigger: A lawful career/appointment decision promotes a formation commander to command a nested army; performance alone creates evidence/opportunity, not automatic rank.
promotion_to_general.commander_transition: The formation's current commander and deputy move upward together to become the new nested army commander and deputy.
promotion_to_general.original_formation: The original formation becomes Unit 1 of the new nested army and keeps its personnel, equipment, history, readiness, casualties and lineage.
promotion_to_general.formation_succession: Qualified embedded officers are elevated into the vacated top formation commander/deputy posts. The best lawful 1,000-echelon officer is the ordinary first candidate for commander; a qualified 500+ officer is the ordinary first candidate for deputy, subject to actual capability/availability.
promotion_to_general.embedded_replacement: Vacated embedded posts may be filled by promoting/reassigning qualified real personnel already inside the formation. Their prior embedded posts may remain vacant or be filled through further lawful internal promotion. Casualty or promotion vacancies never auto-derank surviving officers and never create replacement bodies.
promotion_to_general.headcount_reconciliation: Because the two embedded successors leave counted troop strength when they enter the top formation commander/deputy posts, the formation immediately becomes two bodies understrength. Promotion never auto-pulls reserve or newly recruited bodies. Authorized strength is restored only by a later explicit lawful personnel assignment or reconstitution from conserved manpower.
promotion_to_general.no_spawn_rule: Promotion creates no people, mounts or equipment. It changes command representation and assignments only.
